entries.text: The Linux machine used by make ci-linux and the pr-preflight Linux step is now stopped after every guarded run (set BENCHBOX_KEEP_LINUX_MACHINE=1 to keep it), and the heavy-work sentinel stops it after BENCHBOX_HEAVY_VM_IDLE_MINUTES (default 10) with no lock holder or run process; BENCHBOX_HEAVY_LINUX_MACHINE names the machine. make heavy-status flags a running VM with no lock holder and any UNGUARDED VM RUN, and the setup text now ends with container machine stop.
